gotchas: Guest checkout, no login. /en-gb/ is an airtrfx fares page whose booking widget hands off to /app/make/... Flow: Search Flights -> results -> fare card 'Economy from' -> 'Saver' -> 'Continue with Saver Fare' (upsell dialog) -> Continue -> Passenger Information -> Select seats ('Skip Seat Selection' then 'Continue without seats') -> Add Bags (a carry-on choice radio, 'Check it in - 10kg Bag No Charge' works) -> Enhance your trip (Continue) -> Review & Purchase (/app/make/purchase), which carries the card form. 'Complete Purchase' is the final button.
A OneTrust consent scrim intercepts every click until it is answered; only #onetrust-accept-btn-handler was visible at the first layer.

Widget: trip type is the button aria-label 'fc-booking-journey-type-aria-label, ...' with option 'One way'; From/To take typing on [aria-label="fc-booking-origin-aria-label"] / [aria-label="fc-booking-destination-aria-label"], then click the option such as 'London/Heathrow (LHR), United Kingdom'. Pick a gridcell like '23 Oct 2026, ,' and press 'Done' in the date dialog.

Passenger step: title is the first visible <select>, names input[autocomplete="given-name"]/input[autocomplete="family-name"], email and confirm are input[type=email] nth 0/1, the country code is a [role=combobox] (type the country, click the option), then input[id*="area" i] and input[id*="local" i].

Card number and CVV are TokenEx iframes: iframe[name="tx_iframe_numberIframeContainerId"] (input[autocomplete="cc-number"], id data) and iframe[name="tx_iframe_cvv_cvvIframeContainerId"] (input[autocomplete="cc-csc"]). Expiry is one plain input[autocomplete="cc-exp"] taking MM/YY. Card Type select (option 'Visa Card') sits before the number.
Address Line 1 has a short maxlength: a full street line came back fill_rejected (truncated).
The billing Country select (select[id*="ountry" i]) did not take the country token through selectOption; it timed out waiting for the option. Set it by label instead.
order.total hint '[class*="total" i]' resolved to the right amount (GBP 96.23) before any fill.
